# Recreation Prompt

Recreate **Block Builder: Pastel Pipe Panic**, a mobile-first Three.js voxel sandbox inspired by the source mechanics and the prompt: Block Builder. A satirical game inspired by Mario built around block builder play, with puzzle, creative, one more level energy, lunch break session design, search-friendly hooks like block builder, building game, casual, aesthetics like kawaii, pastel dream, popcore, and meme-tone cues such as its giving, no thoughts head empty. Designed for one-thumb mobile play with touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, fast onboarding, and portrait-first UX tuned for iOS and Android in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

Preserve the mechanic truth: generated block terrain, first-person camera, D-pad movement, right-side drag look, jump, crosshair raycast, mining non-bedrock blocks, placing selected blocks, inventory counts for finite materials, renewable starter block, pause/resume/quit/restart, and fall failure. Transform the presentation into a kawaii pastel, satirical, pipe-adjacent block builder with comic title typography, pixel micro-labels, frosting/cake/brick block materials, compact GIF feedback, popcore audio, and one-thumb portrait controls.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
The preserved source is a browser-native Three.js first-person voxel sandbox. The player starts from a title modal, enters a generated block terrain, moves with a mobile D-pad, drags the right side of the screen to look, jumps, raycasts from the crosshair, mines non-bedrock blocks, places selected blocks, tracks dirt/stone inventory counts, pauses from a settings button, and loses only by falling below the world.

## Protected mechanics
- D-pad forward/back/left/right movement relative to camera yaw.
- Right-side drag look with sensitivity slider.
- Jump only while grounded, gravity and simple axis collision.
- Raycast selection under the crosshair within short range.
- Mine removes targeted non-bedrock blocks and increments matching inventory.
- Place uses the selected block, prevents placing inside the player body, decrements finite non-grass inventory, and keeps grass effectively renewable.
- Pause, resume, quit, restart, and fall-failure state flow.

## Remix target
The new canonical surface is **Block Builder: Pastel Pipe Panic**, a kawaii popcore block-building lunch-break sandbox. The player role is a tiny pipe-adjacent builder scooting through pastel blocks with meme-tone feedback: "its giving" for success and "no thoughts" for failed actions.

## Safe transform surfaces
Title, copy, HUD vocabulary, color system, procedural block textures, start/pause/failure language, background/fog, feedback captions, button treatment, focal badge silhouette, audio mapping, and inventory labels are transformed while the mechanical Three.js kernel is preserved.
